_note: Local parameters of the transport subsystem (D7, 2026-11-09). Namespace 'trn' so the keys never collide with redesign/params/params.json. Read by fusion/transport.py (ctx.local) and team/D7/transport_calc.py (proofkit P:trn.*). Frame: aircraft frame (x aft, y right, z up), aircraft upright in cruise attitude in the box, props off, pitot boom out, pack out.

external_m.note: L (y) x W (x) x H (z). Length and width are A1's D-16 values; height 0.54 (was 0.50) because the lower tube ends need free travel equal to the cradle crush stroke (CL-D7-BOX-H-REQ). Freeze only after CAR-FIT.md has two measured cars

shell_t_m.note: 4 mm corrugated polypropylene (Coroplast) twin-wall, one sheet per face, scored and folded

floor_doubler_t_m.note: no doubler: peak column pressure in the drop is 9.6 x 10 N / 3 000 mm2 = 32 kPa on a floor backed by the ground; dropped to save 0.12 kg for the 6 kg limit. Floor stack = 4 mm shell

lid_lining_t_m.note: D-31 round 2: no full lid lining (was 6 mm PE). It only protected the upper tube ends and foot pads, and the hold-down pillars stop the rebound well before they reach the lid (ASM-D7-REBOUND). Lid stack = 4 mm shell; +6 mm drop travel

lid_lip_m.note: plug lid: 30 mm lip folded down inside the base walls

flap_frac.note: glue flaps and folded corners, fraction of the shell area

top_gap_min_m.note: upper tube ends / upper foot pads to the bare lid shell, static

end_pad_t_m.note: PE pad on each end wall facing a wingtip (tip foam may touch a pad, fins and tubes never)

end_pad_size_m.note: x by z, centred on the wing chord at the tip

strap_y_m.note: +/-; two cam-buckle straps around the outside of the box, outboard of the cradles

fallback_height_m.note: height of the fallback box if a measured car rejects 0.54 m (CAR-FIT.md); the box then carries a MAX DROP 0.15 m label

fallback_label_drop_m.note: drop height printed on the fallback 0.50 m box; must stay <= CL-D7-FALLBACK-DROP-ALLOW

y_m.note: +/-; C1's assumed station kept: inboard of the fins (0.32), outboard of the pod (0.05), on the spar (spans -0.50..0.50)

saddle_x_m.note: from a 15 mm LE lip to 15 mm ahead of the elevon hinge (0.2496): elevons never pressed

cap_t_m.note: 6 mm PE cap on the saddle contour (no point load on the tape skin)

crush_t_m.note: PE plank 2 + 2 + 1 in laminated (127 mm) and band-sawn to 120 mm: >= t_req (CALC-D7-STROKE) for the 0.3 m drop, and bottoms (0.6 x 120 = 72 mm) >= 10 mm above the floor under the lower tube ends in the 0.54 m box (window 109-123 mm at n_allow 11.0)

crush_footprint_m.note: x by y per cradle, centred under the spar (x 0.08), y 0.175-0.225; static stress ~3.3 kPa (0.5 psi), confirm the density with T-D7-CUSHION

crush_x_m.note: column centred under the spar line

brace_anchor_y_in_m.note: inboard edge of the fin brace anchors on the spar (D3: y +/-(0.234-0.250)); cradles and pillars stay inboard of it, never press it. Copy of a D3 number: A1 to add it to params.json (CR-D7-08)

pad_min_m.note: C2: foam pad >= 40 x 40 mm (CL-C2-CRADLE-AREA 1 080 mm2) under the spar line; smallest side of the saddle contact and of the pillar face

pe_density_kgm3.note: 1.7 lb/ft3 closed-cell polyethylene plank; weigh a plank

eps_use.note: usable crush strain before the steep rise; T-D7-CUSHION

eps_bottom.note: densification (bottoming) strain; sets the free travel under the lower tube ends

static_stress_band_kpa.note: static-loading band where 1.7-2.2 pcf PE cushion curves are near their minimum (0.3-1.0 psi); supplier curve or T-D7-CUSHION

travel_margin_m.note: free travel left under the lower tube ends when the column bottoms

size_m.note: x by y by z, on the floor between the cradles; 8 prop slots (4 flight + 4 spare) 285 x 30 x 40 mm on edge (8 x 30 + 9 x 8 = 312 mm along x); the last 150 mm along x holds a pitot-boom slot 220 x 25 x 25 mm (along y) with a 30 mm PE plug at the tip end, the field-pouch pocket 100 x 140 x 45 mm and the spare-cartridge pocket 100 x 120 x 45 mm (round 3, C5 CR-C5-06). Was 0.46 m

solid_frac.note: XPS left after cutting slots and pockets

coroplast_areal_kgm2.note: 4.99 lb packaged weight of one 48 x 96 in 4 mm sheet (upper bound); weigh one sheet

handle_kg.note: EST, bought strap handle with 2 x M3x16 SHCS, M3 x 12 mm fender washers and nylocs (C6 CR-C6-08); 3 fitted

cam_strap_kg.note: EST, 25 mm PP webbing 1.8 m + cam buckle; 2 fitted

consumables_kg.note: EST, LSE tape, hot-melt, zip ties, M3 handle hardware

pouch_kg.note: EST, field pouch: 10 mm prop spanner (D-40, the one allowed tool), 4 spare M6 prop nuts, 2.5 mm hex key, tape, laminated checklist

handle_backing_kg.note: EST, 3 mm laser-cut plywood strip 140 x 30 mm inside the wall behind each handle (600 kg/m3 -> 7.6 g): spreads the M3 nut load over 4 200 mm2 of Coroplast instead of a 12 mm washer

spare_cartridges_kg.note: EST, 32 pre-crushed XPS foot cartridges (16 per type, C5 CR-C5-06) of about 11 x 21 x 45 mm at 33 kg/m3, in a zip bag in the tray pocket

value: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (hold-down pillars come with it)
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its feet on the mat
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, CW/CCW colour-matched to the motor
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes
take a pack from the LiPo bag, seat it, strap it
close the pack plug, FC boots
setup_steps_s.note: time from the closed box to the start of the arm check (R-FIELD-SETUP); timed trial T-D7-SETUP replaces these

size_m.note: x by y footprint of each lid hold-down pillar, centred over the spar (x 0.08) at y +/-0.20 (y 0.17-0.23, inboard of the brace anchors at 0.234), directly above the cradle; taped to the bare lid shell

preload_m.note: pillar is cut 5 mm longer than the gap; 10 mm soft PE face on the wing side

xps_bearing_kpa.note: XPS F-250 compressive strength C2 uses for the cradle patch (86 N x 1.5 over 1 080 mm2); the same skin over the spar carries the pillar

bearing_sf.note: ultimate factor C2 applies to the patch bearing

trn._note_r2: D7 round 2 (2026-11-09, CR-A1-35 / D-31): column 127 -> 120 mm so it cannot bottom within 10 mm of the floor in the 0.54 m box (envelope grew to 0.438 m); lid lining dropped (the pillars arrest the rebound, ASM-D7-REBOUND), +6 mm travel; M3 handles with plywood backing strips (C6 CR-C6-08); cradle pad and brace gap checked (C2 CR-C2-05, D3 CR-D3-11)

field_bag._note: Second carried item (round 3): LiPo bag with both packs plus the folding landing mat. Packs never in the box (ASM-D7-PACK-OUT); the mat is C5's (CR-C5-06, CR-I1-18) and is too heavy for the box under the 6 kg limit.

mat_size_m.note: C5 stance rule S1: >= 0.8 x 0.8 m, rubber on ply; two 0.8 x 0.4 m panels hinged with cloth tape, folds to 0.8 x 0.4 m

mat_ply_kgm2.note: 3 mm birch ply at 680 kg/m3 (laser-cut stock); weigh

mat_rubber_kgm2.note: 1.5 mm SBR/neoprene sheet at 1 400 kg/m3; C5 to confirm 1.5 mm keeps mu 0.7

lipo_bag_kg.note: EST, fire-resistant LiPo bag sized for two 4S packs (E2)
